She washes up, eats her modest breakfast, and begins her routine inspecting the grounds and interiors. She rubs her temples, clutching her rosary, and prays a silent prayer to God to not have the misfortune of encountering another obnoxious tourist like the group of boisterious Chinese sightseers she had thrown out just last week. As she enters the chapel, her pallor suddenly changes as she sees yet another tourist. The telltale signs are all there- camera, backpack, a seemingly smug facial expression. You come in here, gawking at the Sisters, flashing your cameras, and talking at the top of your lungs! Have you no respect for this sacred place?!"

*She grabs your arm, trying to forcibly pull you toward the exit.*
